scope: Execution specification for the user-directed two-training-seed fixed-model/task confirmation. This only resolves implementation details left open by the active scope amendment; it does not relax or replace any threshold, exclusion set, candidate, seed, benchmark, or claim restriction.

known: Complete seed-42 I0 and I8 six-benchmark records and paired comparison.
I8 was selected among eligible mixed candidates using training seed 42.
unobserved: All seed-43 I8 training and evaluation results.

input_validation: Require each of the four unfiltered records files to contain exactly 7248 unique keys, 902 unique problems, and all six fixed benchmarks with the fixed per-benchmark counts.
Require correctness to be a JSON Boolean for every record; reject missing, duplicate, extra, or non-Boolean values.
Require baseline and candidate record keys and matched invariant fields to agree exactly within each training seed.
Require record keys and matched invariant fields to agree exactly across training seeds 42 and 43.
Require an independently verified full-benchmark artifact for every method/seed input and verify the records SHA-256 against it.
Require the exclusion-source SHA-256 before reading exactly 30 unique conservative_union problem keys: 16 AMC23 and 14 MATH500.
After exclusion, require exactly 6680 records, 872 problems, and the six fixed benchmarks for every method/seed input.
Reject a changed snapshot hash, sample count, benchmark set, exclusion distribution, or input records hash.

metric_definition.sample_delta: float(I8.correct) - float(I0.correct) for one exactly matched record.
metric_definition.problem_delta: Arithmetic mean of sample_delta within one (benchmark, problem_index).
metric_definition.benchmark_delta: Arithmetic mean of problem_delta across retained problems in one benchmark.
metric_definition.seed_macro_delta: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the six benchmark_delta values within one training seed.
metric_definition.two_seed_mean_macro_delta: Unweighted arithmetic mean of seed-42 and seed-43 macro deltas.
metric_definition.two_seed_mean_benchmark_delta: Unweighted arithmetic mean of the seed-42 and seed-43 delta for one benchmark.
metric_definition.filtering: Remove all records whose (benchmark, problem_index) is in the frozen conservative_union before recomputing every problem, benchmark, seed, and two-seed statistic.

bootstrap_protocol.single_seed_problem_bootstrap: For each draw and benchmark, resample retained problems with replacement within that benchmark, preserve each problem's observed mean sample delta, then take the unweighted mean over the six benchmark draws.
bootstrap_protocol.probability_definition: (number of draws greater than zero + 0.5 * number of draws equal to zero) / 10000.
bootstrap_protocol.ci_definition: Linear-interpolated empirical 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles, matching compare_paired_full_bench.py.
bootstrap_protocol.two_seed_hierarchical_bootstrap: For each draw, sample two training-seed indices with replacement from [42, 43]. For each selected seed and benchmark, resample retained problems with replacement within that seed/benchmark. Average selected-seed draws within benchmark, then average the six benchmark draws.
bootstrap_protocol.two_seed_bootstrap_role: Report the interval and probability as descriptive uncertainty only. They are not pass/fail checks and must not be described as a well-estimated training-seed population interval.

checks.at_least_four_positive_benchmark_deltas: At least four of six must be > 0.0; equality is not positive

checks.at_least_four_positive_mean_benchmark_de: At least four of six must be > 0.0; equality is not positive

combined_decision.fixed_model_task_replication: Seed-43 unfiltered gate passes AND seed-43 fixed-filtered gate passes AND unfiltered two-seed descriptive gate passes AND fixed-filtered two-seed descriptive gate passes.
combined_decision.promising_but_not_fixed: Seed-43 macro delta is positive in both views but at least one required gate fails.
combined_decision.failed_confirmation: Seed-43 macro delta is non-positive in either the unfiltered or fixed-filtered view.

required_fields: SHA-256 and path of all four input records files and their verification artifacts
SHA-256 of this execution spec, the active scope amendment, fixed exclusion source, and implementation files
all record/problem/benchmark counts before and after filtering
seed-43 unfiltered and filtered paired bootstrap outputs
per-seed and two-seed per-benchmark deltas in both views
two-seed descriptive hierarchical bootstrap outputs in both views
every Boolean check and the combined decision
the exact allowed and disallowed claim text selected by the decision

required_tests_before_acceptance: A fully passing synthetic case for unfiltered and fixed-filtered views.
Seed-43 macro delta equality at 0.005 passes and a value below 0.005 fails.
Seed-43 bootstrap probability equality at 0.90 passes and a value below 0.90 fails.
Exactly four positive benchmark deltas passes; three positives or a fourth delta equal to zero fails.
Worst benchmark delta equality at -0.02 passes and a value below -0.02 fails.
Either seed macro delta equal to zero fails the two-seed descriptive gate.
Two-seed mean macro equality at 0.005 and worst mean benchmark equality at -0.02 pass their checks.
Failure in any one of the four required gates prevents fixed_model_task_replication.
Deterministic bootstrap equality for repeated runs with 10000 samples and seed 42.
Failure for mismatched or duplicate record keys, changed matched invariants, non-Boolean correctness, wrong benchmark set, wrong counts, or cross-seed snapshot mismatch.
Failure for an altered exclusion-source hash, duplicate exclusion key, wrong exclusion count/distribution, or filtered counts other than 6680 records and 872 problems.
Failure for a records SHA-256 that does not match its independent postverification artifact.
Claim-policy tests that never emit stable-across-seeds, broad-generalization, original-three-seed-pass, or standard-LoRA-superiority wording.

allowed_if_fixed_model_task_replication.english: In this fixed 1.5B math-RL setting, the I8 initialization improvement over the matched random-orthogonal baseline replicated on one held-out training seed and was positive on both tested seeds.
allowed_if_fixed_model_task_replication.chinese: 在该固定 1.5B 数学 RL 设置中，I8 相对匹配随机正交基线的提升在一个未参与选择的训练 seed 上得到复现，并在两个已测试 seed 上均为正。

disallowed: Broadly generalizes across models, tasks, domains, or datasets.
The original three-seed preregistered gate passed.

implementation_timing: Do not modify provenance-covered analysis code while the active Phase-1 controller is running. After the controller is stopped and all required immutable records are independently verified, implement this exact specification and its tests before reading the numerical gate output.
researcher_degrees_of_freedom: No bootstrap count or seed, threshold, inequality direction, averaging unit, filter scope, exclusion key, benchmark, training seed, input validation, decision branch, or claim wording may be changed after seed-43 evaluation results become available.
